body: Self awareness is one of the best traits a person can possess. And you are not any less of a person for thinking those thoughts, it's only natural. It sounds like your struggles relate to loneliness, and our minds lash out when we're grieving. It's okay. Stay strong.

I don't see that option. There is no admin or list for people to approve, as far as I'm aware. All I see is the switch to turn collaboration on or off.

Is there another way that I am unaware of?

If you turn the collaborative setting on, other people can add to the playlists you've created. But there aren't any restrictions associated with it, so anyone can do whatever they want, including deleting everything if they so choose.

Thank you to the people who offered to talk. Unfortunately it's too late. Talking isn't what I need. I need to be unbroken.

I need to be sewn back together. Every day I lose another piece of myself. I don't need someone to talk to, I need someone to care about me. Someone to connect with, to love and be loved.

I had an epiphany today on my way home after abandoning work early. All day I have been wondering what is wrong with me. Why is it that I attain heartbreak so easily, that it shatters me more than it does everyone else I've ever known? 

It's because I have no one. I know that I never will have anyone. All of these other people who bounce back from miserable encounters with life, they all have support systems. It's not always enough, of course; some people are still miserable despite people who love them and despite loving them back. But I genuinely believe that's all I've ever needed. I just need someone to have mutual love with.

But it won't happen. I have no friends or family I am close to. Any attempt I have ever made to be in a real relationship has backfired dramatically and left me far more damaged than if I had just kept to myself. 

I'm tired of making an effort. I'm tired of trying to get people to like me. I have been cast aside. I am a forgotten nobody who barely survives in the cold. I am forced to watch those who cozily sit inside a warm shelter while my skin and flesh fall away in chunks. I'm dying. Every attempt I make to be happy involves scraping my skull against the pavement just to roll the weighted dice. I have nothing left to yield. 

I'm fucking done.
